chunks: We adorned the nearest heaven with the adornment of stars.

key_terms.السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا: the nearest heaven (the lowest of the seven heavens)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the stars in the nearest heaven according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'zaynah' (beautification) as a sign of divine power, with some scholars noting the stars' dual role as both decorative elements and markers for navigation and timekeeping. The placement of stars in the 'lowest heaven' underscores the accessibility of the cosmos to human observation, reinforcing the Quranic theme of inviting reflection on creation's order.
